prompt: Brew me a Standard deck built around Gideon's Memorial, Solitary Cell and Ajani Unrelenting.
text:
I built **Boros Token Superfriends**. It's a brew: none of these three cards shows up in a proven list. In the last 90 days Gideon's Memorial and Solitary Cell each appear in 1 list, and Ajani Unrelenting appears in 5.

**The plan**
The deck has almost no regular creatures. All of its bodies are tokens, made by spells and planeswalkers. That turns Ajani Unrelenting's −3 ("4 damage to each creature except for tokens you control") into a sweeper that only hits the opponent. Gideon's Memorial makes those tokens hit harder and helps cast planeswalkers early. Solitary Cell removes an early threat and later turns extra legendary cards into new cards.

**Main deck (60)**
- 4 Gideon's Memorial
- 4 Solitary Cell
- 3 Ajani Unrelenting
- 3 Elspeth, Storm Slayer
- 4 Ajani, Outland Chaperone
- 1 Quintorius Kand
- 4 Burst Lightning
- 2 Get Lost
- 4 Frontline Rush
- 4 Antiquities on the Loose
- 3 Caretaker's Talent
- 24 lands: 4 Sacred Foundry, 4 Inspiring Vantage, 4 Sunbillow Verge, 4 Multiversal Passage, 5 Plains, 3 Mountain

**Why these cards**
- **Gideon's Memorial (4 copies):** Your tokens get +1/+0 and vigilance, and it taps for any color to cast planeswalkers. Play it on turn 2 and you can cast Elspeth on turn 4 or Ajani Unrelenting on turn 5. It's legendary, so only one can be in play at a time. Extra copies still help: discard one to Cell to draw a card, or pay {1}{W} and discard it to deal 4 damage to an attacking or blocking creature.
- **Solitary Cell (4):** Exiles an opponent's nonland permanent with mana value 3 or less. Later, pay {1}, tap it and discard a legendary card to draw. The deck has 15 legendary cards: 4 Memorials and 11 planeswalkers.
- **Ajani Unrelenting (3):** Every time you use a loyalty ability on any of your planeswalkers, you get a 2/2 Cadet token. Then −3 clears the opponent's board, or +1 gives your team +1/+0 and haste for an attack. You have about a 49.5% chance to draw one by turn 6, so it's a strong late-game card rather than something you can count on every game.
- **Elspeth, Storm Slayer:** Doubles every token you make, Cadets included. Its −3 also kills a creature with mana value 3 or more.
- **Token makers:**
  - Frontline Rush is an instant that makes two 1/1s, or pumps one creature.
  - Antiquities on the Loose makes two 2/2s, and you can flash it back later for bigger ones.
  - Ajani, Outland Chaperone makes a 1/1 each turn, and its −2 deals 4 damage to a tapped creature.
  - Caretaker's Talent draws a card each turn you make tokens. At level 3 your creature tokens get +2/+2.
- **Removal:** Burst Lightning and Get Lost.

Your odds of having Memorial or Cell plus a token maker by turn 3 are 65.6%.

**Mana**
I based the land setup on Boros Dragons, which runs about 24 lands, and the deck check passed. It has 17 white and 15 red sources. That's less red than Dragons (about 19 red), because this deck has more cards that need WW. Memorial's any-color mana covers Ajani Unrelenting's RR. Choose Plains or Mountain for each Multiversal Passage depending on what your hand needs.

**Sideboard (15) and plans**
The sideboard is 3 Rest in Peace, 3 Seam Rip, 2 Pyroclasm, 2 Get Lost, 2 Dawn's Truce, 2 Voice of Victory and 1 Lightning Helix.
- **Jund Sacrifice (15.2% of the field):** Bring in Rest in Peace and Seam Rip. Take out Caretaker's Talent and one Frontline Rush. Ajani's −3 is your best card here.
- **Elementals, Landfall, Prowess:** Bring in Pyroclasm, Seam Rip and Helix. Take out Quintorius and some Talents. Cast Pyroclasm before you make tokens, or when your planeswalkers matter more than your board.
- **Dimir Midrange and Azorius/4C Control:** Bring in Voice of Victory (opponents can't cast spells during your turn) and Dawn's Truce to protect your planeswalkers. Take out Burst Lightning.
- **Boros Dragons:** Bring in the extra Get Lost and Helix. Take out some Frontline Rushes.

**What I couldn't check**
This list hasn't been tested against the field, so the matchup notes are reasoning, not results. Antiquities on the Loose, Caretaker's Talent and Ajani, Outland Chaperone have little or no tournament history. If Caretaker's Talent is too slow, the first swap I'd try is Hop to It (makes three 1/1s for 3 mana), which shows up in Boros Aggro lists.
